items.title: The window is per-replica
items.text: Four dispatch replicas each keep their own map, so roughly three quarters of flaps still page and the suppression metric under-reports by the same factor. This is the finding that decides whether the change ships as written.

items.title: Region is not part of the fingerprint
items.text: Same service, two regions, two unrelated failures: the second is suppressed. Adding region is a one-line change and narrows suppression, which is the safe direction.

items.title: The recent map never evicts
items.text: One entry per fingerprint ever seen, held for the life of the process. Bounded in practice by the number of alert rules, which is 3,400 today and not obviously bounded tomorrow.
items.evidence: No eviction path in the file.

items.title: Escalation always pages
items.text: An alert that refires worse than it resolved pages regardless of the window. This is the behaviour the on-call lead asked for and it is implemented correctly.
items.evidence: src/alert/suppress.ts:18, covered by two of the six new tests.
